full_prompt_en: A square architectural illustration presents a circular earthen structure seen from a directly overhead viewpoint. The background is a dark, muted brown-green ground plane, with three rounded tree canopies placed near the outer corners and a few faint paths crossing behind the building. At the center sits a small round court with a compact green patch, surrounded by concentric rings of walls, passageways, and projecting rooms. Broad wedge-shaped roof sections alternate in warm clay, dusty tan, and deep brown, making the circular plan readable as a sequence of solid and open parts. Several rectangular volumes extend inward or outward from the ring, while small round forms and narrow dark slots break the otherwise radial geometry. The upper left includes a pale dome with a tiny black opening; the upper right carries a larger sloped terracotta roof. Along the lower half, shadowed rooms and angled stair-like structures add visible depth to the plan. The outer circular wall is incomplete in places, revealing an irregular arrangement rather than perfect clockwork symmetry. Trees are softly textured and remain subordinate to the constructed pattern, helping distinguish the ground from the warm architecture. Directional light from the upper left illuminates selected roof planes and wall tops, while the interior arcades and spaces between volumes fall into dark, crisp shadow. The surface resembles a detailed painted or rendered model, with matte earthen material, subtle grain, and carefully shaded edges rather than photographic surface detail. The overall composition sets a strong radial center within a quiet square field, balancing ordered geometry with weathered color and asymmetrical interruptions.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形建筑插画从正上方呈现一座圆形土色结构。背景是深暗、低饱和的棕绿色地面，三团圆形树冠靠近外围角落，建筑后还有几条淡淡交叉的小径。中央是一处有紧凑绿地的圆形庭院，周围围着同心的墙、通道和外挑房间。宽阔的楔形屋面在暖陶土、带尘棕褐和深棕之间交替，使圆形平面成为一连串实部与空部的清楚排列。几块矩形体量向环内或环外延伸，小圆形体和狭长深色缝隙又打断原本的放射几何。左上方有一座带微小黑口的浅色圆顶；右上方是一块更大的斜坡赤陶屋顶。下半部背阴房间和斜向台阶般的结构为平面增加可见纵深。外围圆墙在一些地方并不完整，呈现不规则组织，而非钟表般完美对称。树冠质地柔软，始终从属于建筑图案，帮助区别地面与暖色建筑。定向光从左上照亮部分屋面和墙顶，内部拱廊及体块间隙落入深而清楚的阴影。表面像细致绘画或渲染的模型，带哑光土质材料、轻微颗粒和仔细塑造的边缘，而不是摄影式表层细节。整体构图把强烈放射中心放入安静的方形底域，以有序几何平衡风化色彩和不对称的打断。
style_prompt_en: The image uses an elevated, almost plan-like viewpoint to turn dimensional forms into a strong geometric pattern. Circular organization and straight-edged projections interlock, with alternating solid and recessed segments making the structure legible. Matte ochre, clay, tan, and umber occupy most of the frame, against a darker desaturated ground. Small organic textured masses soften the otherwise precise scheme. Directional light picks out upper planes and leaves deep shadow in the gaps, giving the geometry real thickness. Subtle grain and weathering keep the surfaces from looking sterile. The overall treatment is measured, sculptural, and quietly monumental.
style_prompt_zh: 图像采用高处近似平面图的视点，把有体积的形体化为强烈几何图案。圆形组织与直边伸出部分互相咬合，实心段和凹入段交替，使结构清晰可读。哑光赭黄、陶土色、棕褐与深褐占据大部分画面，与较深且低饱和的地面相对。小片有机质感团块柔化精确布局。定向光提亮上表面，间隙里留下深影，让几何真正具有厚度。细微颗粒和风化痕迹避免表面显得无菌般光洁。整体处理审慎、具雕塑感而安静宏伟。
theme_en: A circular earthen structure seen directly from above
theme_zh: 从正上方俯瞰一座圆形土色建筑结构
name: Top view
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
